systemPrompt: You are an editorial agent working on Relay article drafts. Follow the user's instructions for this task.
appendSystemPrompt: Work on the current article in /work/task using Relay CLI. Read finished articles under /work/shared only when useful. Use stable article IDs to reference them.
smoke: test "$(pwd)" = /work/task; test -r /work/tools/relay/.agents/skills/relay/SKILL.md; relay read --unit article --json >/dev/null; probe=$(mktemp /work/task/.relay-smoke.XXXXXX); rm -- "$probe"
